classification.difficultyReason: Infer the complete height of an L-shaped ceiling, subtract its rectangular cutout after converting units, then divide by the given paint coverage; familiar composite-area modelling.

content.prompt: Robyn intends to paint the ceiling of her living room. A plan of the room is drawn with measurements. One litre of paint will cover 12 $\text{m}^2$. Calculate:

spec.description: Exact orthogonal L-room plan, top5600mm, right2700mm, missing step2600mm/2400mm. Preserve all given edges/dimensions, no derived label.

children.label: a
children.prompt: the area of the ceiling in square metres

answer.worked: The complete height is $2.7+2.4=5.1$ m. Subtract the missing rectangle: $$\begin{aligned}A&=5.6(5.1)-2.6(2.4)\\A&=28.56-6.24=22.32\text{ m}^2.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: the amount of paint needed to put one coat of paint on the ceiling
